source.commit_body:
Lift table rebuilt from v34 production scores (pre_boost extracted from
weight_info to remove v28-boost contamination). v27 table was based on
v27 score distribution; v32/v33/v34 changes shifted the distribution
substantially (CWCF dampener pulls 75+ wadj<0 calls down; continuation
boost elevates 70-74 calls; CSWC dampener filters call stoch-weekly
contradictions).

Calibration changes (database/utils/scoring.py):
  - LIFT_TABLE_PATH: experiments/v27_optimization/phase_tp3b_lift_table.json
                  → experiments/v34_calibration/lift_table_v34.json
  - EARN_BOOST_MAX:        0.50 → 0.55
  - EARN_BOOST_LIFT_NORM_CALL: 22.3 → 14.0
  - EARN_BOOST_LIFT_NORM_PUT:  16.3  (unchanged)
  - EARN_BOOST_WINDOW:      5      (unchanged)

Phase 1 sweep over saturation/window/admit threshold gradients narrowed
to a 2D MAX × NORM_CALL grid. Phase 3 fine-grid winner V34_M55_NC14
strictly passes H1-H5 per-trade gate at 1y/3y/5y:

  5y per-trade WR15 vs prior calibration (v27 table, MAX=0.50, NC=22.3):
    95+   76.42% N=123 → 80.62% N=129  (ΔWR +4.20pp / ΔN +4.9%)
    90+   72.04% N=540 → 76.22% N=534  (ΔWR +4.18pp / ΔN -1.1%)
    85+   74.80% N=1,881 → 75.66% N=2,034  (ΔWR +0.86pp / ΔN +8.1%)
    80+   69.68% N=6,330 → 70.66% N=6,895  (ΔWR +0.98pp / ΔN +8.9%)
    75+   66.47% N=19,062 → 66.47% N=19,128  (flat)
    <5    61.00% N=1,482 → 63.71% N=1,761  (ΔWR +2.72pp / ΔN +18.8%)
    <15   60.67% N=12,155 → 60.83% N=12,389  (ΔWR +0.16pp)
    <25   57.90% (unchanged)

Multi-window sign consistency (1y / 3y / 5y):
  95+: +3.33 / +4.21 / +4.20  ✓
  90+: +8.59 / +4.95 / +4.18  ✓
  85+: -0.97 / +0.61 / +0.86  (1y noise on small N=435)
  80+: +0.68 / +0.86 / +0.98  ✓

H1-H5 strict gate (5y) PASS — no per-trade regression beyond -1.0pp;
4 of 5 call tiers improve ≥+0.5pp; N stability all within ±15%; <5/<15
puts strictly improve.

No MC required per assessment-backtest.md "Why N=300 canonical MC is
NOT the gate for scoring changes" — H1-H5 per-trade gate is sufficient.

Calibration artifacts in experiments/v34_calibration/:
  - build_lift_table_preboost.py (cleanly rebuilds the lift table)
  - sweep_boost_params.py        (Phase 1: gradient over thresholds)
  - sweep_phase2_combined.py     (Phase 2: combined variants + alpha)
  - sweep_phase3_finegrid.py     (Phase 3: 2D MAX × NORM_CALL grid)
  - verify_winner.py             (final per-tier multi-window detail)
  - lift_table_v34.json          (production table, ship copy)
